# This file was automatically generated for projects
# without default 'CMakeLists.txt' file.

# Generate the embedded web asset (src/web/tuning_html_gz.c) BEFORE globbing
# sources, so it is included in app_sources even on a fresh checkout where the
# gitignored generated file is absent. execute_process is scriptable, so it also
# runs cleanly during IDF's component-requirements expansion pass. The asset is
# also (re)generated by tools/build_web_asset.py, which must be re-run after
# editing any src/web/* source (see src/web/README.md). It is a plain compiled
# source rather than a CMake EMBED_FILES entry because the toolchain embed paths
# are unreliable under PlatformIO's ESP-IDF integration.
execute_process(
    COMMAND python3 ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/build_web_asset.py
    RESULT_VARIABLE _web_rc)
if(NOT _web_rc EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "build_web_asset.py failed (rc=${_web_rc})")
endif()

FILE(GLOB_RECURSE app_sources ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.c)

idf_component_register(SRCS ${app_sources})
# The generated version.h dir is on the compile include path via platformio.ini's
# `-I .pio/build/${PIOENV}` build flag (written by tools/pio_gen_version.py).
